questions.stem: This diagram shows a drug entering a hepatocyte, being loaded onto the RISC complex, and directing degradation of PCSK9 mRNA. By what mechanism does this agent (inclisiran) lower LDL cholesterol?

choices.label: A
choices.text: It is a small interfering RNA that silences PCSK9 mRNA, reducing PCSK9 synthesis

choices.label: B
choices.text: It blocks intestinal absorption of dietary and biliary cholesterol at the brush border

choices.label: C
choices.text: It sequesters bile acids in the gut lumen to increase their fecal excretion

choices.label: D
choices.text: It is a monoclonal antibody that directly binds and neutralizes circulating LDL particles

choices.label: E
choices.text: It competitively inhibits HMG-CoA reductase to block hepatic cholesterol synthesis

explanation.summary: Inclisiran is a siRNA that harnesses the RISC pathway to degrade PCSK9 mRNA. Less PCSK9 means fewer LDL receptors are targeted for lysosomal destruction, so more receptors recycle to the surface and clear more LDL from the blood.
